tool_args.rationale: The pilot shows sink-gradient dependence but leaves genuine ambiguity among the archived siphon and inhibition mechanisms. The open-branch probe is the least costly targeted measurement available.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the inland-hub siphon with a positive or negative square-root branch
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five pilot observations do not reliably distinguish the open branch from competing sink-coupled mechanisms.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit cooperative Hill inhibition or barrier-modulated siphon
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Both have four fitted parameters and remain plausible with only five pilot rows; the branch probe can discriminate them.
A static branch-discriminating probe is cheaper and better targeted to the observed sink-gradient signatures.
It is irrelevant to the mechanism ambiguity.
